reviewFindings: The recorded debate is kingship at Chen versus urgent western advance and restoration of the six states; not a documented three-round council.
Composite delegations, sealed offer, grain accounts, numerical thresholds, title deferral and every alternate outcome are explicitly reconstruction.
No invented speech is presented as a quotation by Chen Sheng, Zhang Er or Chen Yu.
Arrival mapping is disclosed as a game conversion from Chapter I, not a historical path guarantee.
Each authority policy has a viable common-front route; no opening Pareto-dominates the other two across the five metrics.
Promises have previewed conditional costs. Outcomes are deterministic, not forecasts of real history or autonomous historical AI.
No new image, voice, music, video, copyrighted translation or source scan is included. Human historical/prose/playtest review remains open.
